pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with distinct edge gradients. Larger, irregular patches are observed on the lower neck/shoulder transitioning to smaller, more uniform shapes on the mid-neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is narrow relative to patch diameter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D contour along the dorsal neck with frequent, low-amplitude peaks visible against the background.
